verdict.rationale: Make documents a native Make AI Agents app for agentic automation (make-docs-9), plus AI Agents API endpoints to create, update, and run agents, currently in open beta (make-docs-37). This shows built-in agent capabilities inside the product. However, the evidence does not describe an in-product assistant that users delegate tasks to directly. The MCP server and Skills material covers external assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT, not a built-in one. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-app conversational assistant that users hand tasks to, details on what tasks can be delegated, GA status beyond open beta, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
